items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: He's a trombone player. That was the leader... Poico is his real name.

ctx.x: Yeah. I think he played the Black and Pan band. Did you hear them? Yeah, Ernest Johnson. Was that, um, the name of Southern? I can't think of his name. That's right, Harry Southern.

He's a trombone player. That was the leader. That was the trombone player. He was a leader. Ernest Johnson was with them? Yeah, Ernest Johnson. We call him Nene. Bright fella. What did he play? Something. That's Ernest... That's, that's Peele's brother. You heard of Lil' Peele? Yeah, and that's... Well, that's his brother. Nene. Nene, yeah, yeah. Nene Poico. Poico is his real name. That's right, that's right, that's right. Ernest Johnson is Dr. Ernest. But he changed... No, no, he changed his name out there.…

He's not there, he is. If I remember rightly, Dink told me that they used to tell him that he was their brother or cousin or something sometimes. Did he? Did he? Yeah. He wasn't related at all, but they'd tell people that. Sometime, you know, I don't know why. Yeah, I guess so.
